title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lift]
description: This is an open-air, wooden box which is suspended on a beam trellis that is precariously attached to the side of the mountain.  There are plenty of openings which afford a great view, but the cab itself is covered (probably to guard against falling rocks).

18182.msg: Waiting for 'ledge comes into view'.  This may take around four minutes.

18182.for: ledge comes into view and the cab grinds to a clunky halt
